response.overview: Duck Facts is a comical mixed media (live action and animation) short film about collaboration, creativity, activism, and AI in the modern world viewed through the lens of college students Fred and Natasha, and their new-found feathery friend, Freddy. Realizing how AI is affecting their creative pursuits and future prospects, Fred takes a stand against it. Only after some failed activism does he realize that he is wildly underequipped. The discovery and saving of Freddy the duck prompts some bonding between Fred and his classmate, Natasha, and he shares his frustrations. What will they do when it seems the world is set out against them and they feel powerless?
response.title: Duck Facts
